flag_note: A November 1967 Japan Music Trades advertisement shows the Greco No. 35 Fuzz Booster in the same distinctive wedge format associated with the later Sekova No. 59 Distortion Box. Current historical research strongly links pre-Maxon Greco effects to Nisshin Onpa, but the 1967 advertisement alone does not prove that Nisshin Onpa physically built the No. 35. Preserve the product-level relationship as a high-priority attribution lead, not a confirmed factory assignment.

Keep Aria and Greco as marketed identities and Nisshin Onpa as the physical manufacturer where the model-specific evidence supports it; do not duplicate them as independent factory records.
